change: Add a third interacting bug: the idempotency check uses a composite key of (provider, amount_cents, merchant_id) instead of (provider, provider_transaction_id), so duplicate-amount charges from the same merchant are silently deduplicated on re-import, causing balances to be understated when a merchant has two legitimate charges of identical amounts. This means the solver must fix three interacting issues: (1) float rounding, (2) refund matching by provider_transaction_id rather than amount, and (3) the idempotency key. Fixing any two of the three will pass some but not all generated test cases. Update the verifier to include merchants with multiple same-amount charges and cross-day refunds, and add an explicit idempotency assertion that counts rows after two imports and verifies the count equals one import's worth of distinct transactions.
